text:
[IRET.11.5] `max_fires = 0` means unlimited (run until
empty). The existing `ds_engine_pump` contract maps to
`ds_rete_run(engine, 0, NULL)`.

---

idris.name: iret_11_4__run
idris.note: Fuel 0 fires nothing here rather than meaning unlimited: a total function cannot run unboundedly. The unlimited run is what `Lcyc_1_1__diverges` and `lcyc_1_1__certified_terminates` reason about instead, as propositions rather than an executable.

idris.name: iret_11_4__run_tms
idris.note: Fuel zero fires nothing rather than meaning unlimited, as for the core's `iret_11_4__run`; the unlimited run is what the termination theorems are about.

idris.name: iret_11_4__run_net
idris.note: The run takes its fuel; the unlimited pump is the run with fuel enough.

idris.name: iret_11_4__run_net_view
idris.note: The view survives any fuel.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_1__run_marks_all
idris.note: '`max_fires = 0` means unlimited': the run with fuel above the unfired count is the unlimited run, halting on the drained agenda with its count.

idris.name: iret_11_4__run_net_traced
idris.note: The traced loop halts on an empty agenda or on the fuel, and says which.

idris.name: iret_11_4__run_net_traced_by
idris.note: THE TRACED RUN IS THE ONE TRACED FOLD at its named firing (Rete/RunFold.idr's `iret_11_4__trace_by`), by induction on the fuel. The bridge the trace-is-the-run goes through.

idris.name: iret_11_4__run_net_traced_core
idris.note: The trace agrees with the run on the halt.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_1__run_frame
idris.note: The result is stated for any fuel: an unlimited run is the run with fuel enough, and a run out of fuel is accounted for by the halt.

idris.name: iret_11_4__run_ttl_net_traced
idris.note: The traced loop halts on an empty agenda or on the fuel, and says which.

idris.name: iret_11_4__run_ttl_net_traced_by
idris.note: THE TRACED CLOCKED RUN IS THE ONE TRACED FOLD at its named firing (Rete/RunFold.idr's `iret_11_4__trace_by`), by induction on the fuel. The bridge the trace-is-the-run and the two step-wise unfoldings go through.

idris.name: iret_11_4__run_ttl_net_traced_cons
idris.note: A firing consumes one unit of fuel: the run with `S n` from before it is the run with `n` from after it, with the firing in front.

idris.name: iret_11_4__run_ttl_net_traced_core
idris.note: The trace agrees with the run on the halt.

idris.name: iret_11_4__run_ttl_net_traced_end
idris.note: With fuel left and nothing to fire, the halt is `Quiescent`, not `FuelOut`.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_1__fuel_out_count_ttl
idris.note: What the frame theorem says of a run that halts on the fuel, read at its instance: the firings and the activations left unfired account for every activation unfired before. Computed.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_1__run_frame_ttl
idris.note: The result is stated for any fuel: an unlimited run is the run with fuel enough, and a run out of fuel is accounted for by the halt.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_1__two_facts_fuel_out_ttl
idris.note: The clause's fuel exhausted, executed: with fuel 1 the two-fact run halts `FuelOut` after one firing, with matches left unfired. Fuel is not assumed to suffice.

idris.name: iret_11_4__run_net_marks_all
idris.note: '`max_fires = 0` means unlimited': the run with fuel above the unfired count is the unlimited run, halting on the drained agenda with its count.

idris.name: iret_11_4__run_net_ordered
idris.note: The order survives any fuel.

idris.name: iret_11_4__run_g
idris.note: The ghost's run takes the same fuel.

idris.name: iret_11_4__run_net_by
idris.note: The network's halt is the fold's.

idris.name: iret_11_4__run_sound
idris.note: The ghost stays sound under any fuel.

idris.name: iret_11_4__run_tms_net
idris.note: The run halts on an empty agenda or on the fuel, and says which.

idris.name: iret_11_4__run_tms_net_by
idris.note: The network's halt with truth maintenance is the fold's.

idris.name: rlow_4_2_1__run_tms_agree
idris.note: The runs agree under any fuel, so under fuel enough to drain the agenda: the clause's unlimited run.

idris.name: iret_11_4__run_tms_net_traced
idris.note: The traced pump halts on an empty agenda or on the fuel, and says which.

idris.name: iret_11_4__run_tms_net_traced_core
idris.note: THE TRACE IS THE PUMP'S: the same engine, the same halt, and as many firings as the pump counted.

idris.name: iret_11_4__run_ttl_net_traced
idris.note: The traced clocked pump halts on an empty agenda or on the fuel, and says which.

idris.name: iret_11_4__run_ttl_net_traced_core
idris.note: THE TRACE IS THE CLOCKED PUMP'S: the same engine, the same halt, and as many firings as the pump counted.

idris.name: iret_11_4__run_by_fl
idris.note: FireLoop's halt is the fold's.

idris.name: rlow_4_2_1__run_agree
idris.note: The run agrees under any fuel, so under fuel enough to drain the agenda: the clause's unlimited run.

idris.name: iret_11_4__run_well
idris.note: A run under any fuel keeps the state well-formed; `max_fires = 0` as unlimited is the same run with fuel enough.

idris.name: iret_11_4__run_ttl_by
idris.note: The halt of FireLoop's run with the deadline table is the fold's.

idris.name: iret_11_4__run_ttl_net
idris.note: The bounded run on the network, the deadline table threaded through.

idris.name: iret_11_4__run_ttl_net_by
idris.note: The clocked network's halt is the fold's.

idris.name: rlow_4_2_1__run_ttl_agree
idris.note: A RUN AGREES under any fuel: the same firings, the same halt, the same count, the same deadlines; the clock is the pump's own.

idris.name: iret_11_4__run_by
idris.note: The fold halts on the step refusing or on the fuel, and says which: `Quiescent` or `FuelOut`.

idris.name: iret_11_4__trace_by
idris.note: The traced fold halts as the fold does, and says which.

idris.name: iret_11_4__trace_by_cons
idris.note: A firing consumes one unit of fuel: the run with `S n` from before it is the run with `n` from after it, with the firing in front.

idris.name: iret_11_4__trace_by_core
idris.note: The trace agrees with the run on the halt.

idris.name: iret_11_4__trace_by_end
idris.note: With fuel left and nothing to fire, the halt is `Quiescent`, not `FuelOut`.

idris.name: iret_11_4__run_tms_by
idris.note: The engine's halt is the fold's.

idris.name: iret_11_4__run_ttl
idris.note: The fuel is the clause's `max_fires`; the run with the deadline table reports the halt as the engine's does, and agrees with it on the engine.
